$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Group: the code rounds the first and last items, not the group (it has no fill or stroke of its own). Button Group Text: no radius in Figma either. Width: the group and Button Group Text hug their labels, whose widths follow glyph rasterisation; the size check still covers it.

Button.$why: Figma wraps each item in a Start / Middle / End instance with no padding; the code's item is the Button itself, compared on "Button/Button".

Button/Button.$why: The button hugs its label (width follows glyph rasterisation, as in references/button).

Container.$why: The label frame hugs its text (width follows rasterisation; the inline span is one line box tall).
